values.description: Update this to match the port shown when you run 'dotnet run' in src/TeamBuilder.Api. Check the console output for 'Now listening on: https://localhost:<port>'.
Replace with a real player ID from POST /api/v1/players or your local database.
Replace with a real team ID from POST /api/v1/teams or your local database.
Replace with a real event ID from POST /api/v1/events or your local database.
Replace with a real join request ID from POST /api/v1/joinrequests or your local database.
Replace with a real roster import ID from POST /api/v1/rosterimports or your local database.
